Subject: Sponsor stream tiering + registrant consent matrix for June 24 webinar

Hi Taylor / Lina —

Thanks for agreeing to join the technical planning loop for the June 24 webinar. Two coordination asks from Redwood Events before we lock encoder profiles and registration fields: 

1) Stream tiering: Acme will have two sponsor tiers — "Premier" (live intro + sponsor video) and "Partner" (logo + 30s preroll). We need to confirm the exact switch points and whether ON24 can perform server-side preroll insertion for Partner tier (we prefer server-side to avoid replay discrepancies).

2) Registrant consent mapping: Acme requires a separate opt-in for receiving sponsor follow-ups and a consent flag in the registrant export so their CRM can segment attendees. I've attached a first-pass consent matrix (registrant-consent-mapping-v1.pdf) mapping Zoom/ON24 fields -> Acme CRM fields. Please confirm what field names ON24 will include in the CSV export and whether you can add a custom boolean ("consent_to_acme_marketing").

Tech details / preferred fallback plan: 
- Primary: ON24 RTMP ingest into Redwood encoder pool (we provide keys).
- Fallback A: Zoom Webinar stream with passcode gating behind the registration form.
- Fallback B: Pre-recorded MP4 served via ON24 if live connect fails > 3 minutes.

Attachments: encoder-tiering matrix (on24-encoder-tiering-matrix.xlsx) includes required bitrates, keyframe interval, and expected failover timings.

Ask: Taylor — can you confirm the export field names and confirm server-side preroll for Partner tier by EOD Thursday (6/4)? Lina — please confirm Acme's legal team is okay with the proposed consent text in the PDF (I've highlighted the short form).

Thanks,
Chloe

Hey Chloe —

Quick answers below after reviewing your matrix and the encoder sheet: 

- Server-side preroll: Yes, ON24 supports server-side preroll for the Partner tier. We can configure a 30s preroll asset per tenant; please provide final MP4s 72 hours before show time.
- Export fields: We will include these fields in the registrant export: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, registration_source, marketing_consent (boolean). We can add a custom boolean field titled "consent_to_acme_marketing" but that requires a one-time config change in ON24 (we can do it; please confirm before 6/4).
- Failover behavior: RTMP -> Zoom Webinar is fine; your 3-minute threshold works. For our side, there will be a 45s buffer to attempt reconnection before triggering the pre-recorded asset.

One gotcha: Zoom Webinar passcode gating only surfaces the passcode in the Zoom registration confirmation email; if you need the passcode added to the ON24 registrant confirmation flow we can surface it but it will be a separate field.

We'll provision the custom field once you confirm the exact field name. Also, please upload the premier-tier video to the Drive link you shared (we need final assets by EOD 6/21 to hit encoding windows).

Cheers,
Taylor Hughes
